body:
`torch.nn.LSTMCell` has the same bug(maybe).

Test code:
```python
import torch
m = torch.nn.LSTMCell(1,1)
input = torch.randn(1,1)
hx = torch.randn(1,1,5,127,1)
cx = torch.randn(1,1)
hx, cx = m(input,(hx,cx))
```
